title: Ansispire VPS lifecycle task payload (vps_task extra_vars contract)
description: Contract for playbooks/vps/examples/*.yml — the `vps_task` extra_vars payload consumed by the VPS lifecycle playbooks (audit / onboard / modify / remove / docker_host / deploy_compose) via the Semaphore Task API or `ansible-playbook -e @file`. These files are NOT playbooks; associating this schema via the `# yaml-language-server: $schema=vps_task.schema.json` modeline stops editors from mis-validating them against the Ansible playbook schema. Validation entry: make test-vps-examples-schema. Inner fields are intentionally permissive — the playbooks themselves are the field-level contract; this schema pins the top-level envelope and the allowed section names.

vps_task.description: The single top-level task envelope. Only the sections below are recognised; a typo'd or unknown section is a schema error.

bootstrap.description: onboard: initial root@port transport used to take over the host (host/port/user/auth).

managed.description: onboard: the managed user to create (user/groups/authorized_keys/sudo).

ssh.description: onboard: SSH hardening + the managed_port to move to, and whether to close the bootstrap port after success.

profile.description: onboard: baseline profile toggles (base_packages / unattended_upgrades / system_limits).

packages.description: onboard: package install/remove lists applied during baseline.

network_tuning.description: onboard/modify: optional sysctl tuning (bbr / tcp_fastopen / mtu_probing).

fail2ban.description: onboard/modify: fail2ban enable + sshd jail settings.

changes.description: modify: the change-set applied to an already-onboarded host (packages/firewall/fail2ban/network_tuning).

options.description: remove: de-registration options (e.g. remove_remote_sshd_dropin). Keeps users/keys by default.

checks.description: audit: which read-only health checks to run (disk/memory/failed_services/reboot_required).

thresholds.description: audit: warning/critical thresholds for the checks.

expose.description: deploy_compose: how the service is exposed (e.g. cloudflare_tunnel).
